decisions.decision: Commission will take the proposed 'or a portion of the property' wording in Section (i) to Town Counsel to change or define it.
decisions.quote: dave said that they will bring that up to counsel to change it or define it.

decisions.decision: Commission agreed that the easement provision is for an easement across one adjoining property under a hardship case, not across multiple properties.
decisions.quote: dave agreed that it would be an easement going across an adjoining property under a hardship case- not across multiple properties.

decisions.decision: Commission will discuss with Counsel, at the Town Meeting on 5/7, making clear in the Bylaw that waivers are not for new construction.
decisions.quote: dave agreed and said they will discuss it with counsel at the town meeting on 5/7.

decisions.decision: Commission will develop verbiage addressing undeveloped parcels, so that it does not do easements across town; the goal stated is to serve those paying betterments.
decisions.quote: dave suggested coming up with verbiage to address this and they do not want to do easements all over town.

decisions.decision: Article 25 will be presented as written, with amendments to be voted on from the floor at Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: barb added that the article will be presented as is, but they can vote on amendments on the floor.
